definitions.gloss: solidarity; unity; standing united; pulling together
definitions.explanation: A group coming together with a shared purpose and acting as one. A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) emphasizing collective resolve and cooperation.

examples.japanese: {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}して{頑張|がんば}ろう。
examples.english: Let's unite and do our best.

examples.japanese: チームが{一致団結|いっちだんけつ}して{勝利|しょうり}をつかんだ。
examples.english: The team pulled together and seized victory.

examples.japanese: {危機|きき}に{直面|ちょくめん}したとき、{社員|しゃいん}{全員|ぜんいん}が{一致団結|いっちだんけつ}して{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: When facing a crisis, all the employees united and overcame it.

notes:
A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character idiom) combining {一致|いっち} (agreement, unity) and {団結|だんけつ} (solidarity, unity). Emphasizes a group acting with one mind and purpose.

USAGE:
Often used with して as an adverb: {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}して (in unity, with solidarity). Common in speeches, team contexts, and situations calling for collective action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}して{取|と}り{組|く}む: to tackle something together
- {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}して{戦|たたか}う: to fight together as one
- {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}の{精神|せいしん}: the spirit of solidarity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一丸|いちがん}となる: to become one, to unite (similar meaning, also very common)
- {結束|けっそく}する: to band together — more general
- {協力|きょうりょく}する: to cooperate — less emphatic about unity of purpose
